page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8te.16xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive workloads. It is powered by a 64-vCPU dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C processor based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system includes 512.0 GB of memory, providing an allocation of 8.0 GB per core, running on a KVM hypervisor.

The hardware configuration incorporates four NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs delivering an aggregate total of 192 GB of video memory. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 64 Gbps to accommodate high-volume network traffic. Local storage is not bundled with the server, necessitating network-attached storage for system volumes and persistence. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

From an architecture standpoint, the density of four modern GPUs alongside 512 GB of host memory maximizes throughput for parallel acceleration pipelines. A key architectural tradeoff is the complete reliance on external block storage, which shifts I/O latency dependencies entirely onto storage network performance. The ecs.gn8te.16xlarge is positioned for multi-GPU artificial intelligence model inference, visual computing, 3D rendering pipelines, and parallel scientific computations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8te.16xlarge is a high-performance GPU compute instance configured with an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at 3.3 GHz. The instance features 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs alongside 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per-core allocation. Hardware acceleration is provided by four NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs supplying 192 GB of total video memory. Network throughput features a 64 Gbps baseline, supporting demanding inter-node communications. Local disk storage is not bundled, requiring external network-attached volumes for data retention, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provided. With its quad Ada Lovelace GPU array, high system memory density, and dedicated Intel processing capacity, the instance is targeted at distributed AI inference, large model fine-tuning, complex 3D rendering pipelines, and high-performance scientific simulations.
